# AtlasBoard v5.49.12ed — Manual RTDB game-version policy + proposed main-menu idle disconnect (2026-11-13)

**STATUS: UNITY CLIENT POLICY SOURCE IMPLEMENTED / SOURCE GATE TO BE RUN / UNITY COMPILER NOT RUN / RTDB RULES & VALUES NOT DEPLOYED.** Previous Passport and Museum owner acceptance remains intact. All earlier roadmap history below is preserved verbatim.

## Release-policy implementation (Spark / Realtime Database only)

- Owner's exact Firebase control path is `/gameversion`: `currentgameversion = "v0.9.1"` and `lastgameversion = "v.0.9.0"`. The version node contains text only. The owner can change either value manually in Firebase Console without rebuilding the already-shipped Unity binary; a client build still needs its own correct PlayerSettings bundle version when a new executable is released.
- Existing `AtlasBoardReleaseVersionBadge` is expanded in place (no second version manager, no new Editor tab). It reads the public, read-only `/gameversion` policy at startup and on a bounded 60-second interval. A failure to fetch policy is distinguished from an actual unsupported build and presents a localized retry screen. Until a policy is confirmed, the menu is guarded rather than silently admitting an unknown build.
- **Current version**: full allowed path, no popup. **Last version**: allowed path with a localized, dismissible update recommendation (`Later` / `Daha Sonra`); shown once per current/last policy pair during the process lifetime. **Neither value**: blocking update screen that cannot simply be dismissed; retry is available for manual policy change. The comparison is exact after normalizing only `v` / `v.` prefixes and a specifically documented release alias, never broad numerical range arithmetic.
- Historical version list sits beside the Unity policy code: `0.1.0`, `0.5.0`, `0.9.0-beta.1`, `0.9.0`, `0.9.1`. **Special migration mapping**: the shipped `0.9.0-beta.1` build maps deliberately to the `v.0.9.0` family. This does not magically update existing old executables; it only governs binaries that include the new check.
- `ProjectSettings/ProjectSettings.asset` and existing `AtlasBoardReleaseVersionEditor.cs` target `0.9.1` and Android `versionCode=10`, without overwriting a future custom build version. Online lobby snapshot checks retain protocol/rules/content checks; a room on either of the two server-approved release families may participate with the other when their gameplay protocol remains compatible.
- Add `/gameversion` **read-only to clients** through existing Firebase Rules; only an operator can update the data via Firebase Console/CLI. `Backend/Firebase/gameversion_initial.json` holds the two exact owner values. The full-file `phase19ee_gameversion_rules_prepare.cjs` reviews existing local Rules and backs them up outside the project before any explicit local write; it never deploys or modifies unrelated branches. Firebase Rules byte limit (262,144) is a hard failure, not a reason to weaken wallet or online security.
- No paid functions/Blaze, second roadmap, second version manager, PS1 or patch-only delivery. The Unity gate applies only after clients receive this updated build. **SERVER-SIDE ADMISSION HARDENING — OPEN**: already-distributed executables do not gain a new version check, and RTDB Security Rules cannot attest an arbitrary binary's true identity from a client-supplied string. Before declaring server-enforced old-client rejection PASS, design/test a migration-compatible admission protocol and ensure active legacy clients are not accidentally locked out when `lastgameversion` is accepted. Avoid treating a client-side overlay as a cryptographic server lock.
- **Do not auto-deploy** production Rules or mutate `/gameversion` as part of building the ZIP. The owner will run dry-run, emulators and explicit deployment, then manually change the values to test CURRENT / PREVIOUS / UNSUPPORTED / OFFLINE. Current Unity source should never claim production PASS before an Android/Windows Unity compile and online acceptance test.

## ACCEPTANCE — version rollout (OPEN until owner tests)

1. Android and Windows/Steam local `Application.version=0.9.1` plus Firebase current `v0.9.1` show a normal lobby. A prior compatible build on the upgraded policy (including explicit `0.9.0-beta.1` alias) sees an update recommendation, can dismiss it and continue.
2. Manually change Firebase to `currentgameversion=v0.9.2` and `lastgameversion=v0.9.1`: the current `0.9.1` executable is allowed but warned. Change to `v0.9.3/v0.9.2`: the same executable must be blocked and see its required/current values. Reset values and retry: access returns without app data loss.
3. A policy read failure, invalid JSON, or absent values must not be misreported as a confirmed old version. Ensure UI retry and no uncontrolled polling/connection load. Verify localized messages in all seven supported languages.
4. Test room-create/join/reconnect/rematch on both supported versions when protocol, content and rules match. Test protocol mismatch separately: it must still reject. Confirm the older already-distributed binary's limitations rather than claiming it can now obey new Firebase flags.
5. Production checks: source gate, exact Rules dry-run/baseline backup, Auth + RTDB emulator read isolation, production deploy confirmation, live `/gameversion` value reads, Unity build, owner acceptance. Never label SERVER-SIDE ADMISSION PASS based solely on client popup behavior.

## OWNER QA — identity transition

- **Guest → registered account flow: OWNER QA PASS 4/4** reported on 2026-11-13: four attempts without a visible error. Preserve this tested flow. It is not conclusive for Steam UID mapping or cross-account cache/isolation under all conditions; keep those distinct acceptance checks OPEN rather than needlessly rewriting completed work.

## PENDING — MAIN-MENU IDLE DISCONNECT (DESIGN ONLY, NOT IMPLEMENTED)

- **Scope**: Only while the user is on the actual Main Menu, with no active online room, live match, invite acceptance, reward payment, purchase, asset load or pending profile write. Do not trigger during an active match, lobby, ongoing async network operation, or background transaction. This is a new future task; no timeout listener or splash image was added to this release.

Observe mouse clicks, key presses, controller buttons, touch taps and supported navigation actions, not mere cursor hover/animations/background refresh. Foreground/window focus and Android app pause/resume need explicit rules; pause must not corrupt sessions or prematurely sign users out.

Owner expects 100 concurrent connections; confirm the quota applicable to the actual SDK/REST patterns and measure connections with Firebase Console before treating 5-minute idle disconnect as a proven capacity fix. Track retained sockets, traffic, app-paused behavior and multi-device interactions before/after.

## Delivery policy

# AtlasBoard v5.49.12eb — Passport per-stamp weekly imprint correction (2026-11-13)

**STATUS: CLIENT/RULES SOURCE UPDATED; SOURCE GATE AND EMULATOR REQUIRE VERIFICATION; UNITY COMPILER NOT RUN; NO PRODUCTION DEPLOY.** This entry supersedes **only** the erroneous *global* weekly-limit interpretation in `dz`/`ea`. Historical entries remain intact. All owner-accepted Museum/Profile behavior and completed Passport work are preserved.

## Owner correction and live evidence

- Owner's rule: each **individual stamp** may be pressed once per Monday-UTC week; using stamp X must never block distinct stamp Y in that same week. After the next week begins, the player can remove and reposition the already printed stamp X. Once a stamp from an earlier week is removed, its one new press for the current week remains possible; no unlimited repeats of the same stamp.
- Owner-supplied production export for Jr. Vuartex shows `atlasPassport/owned/{long_voyage,tr_horizon}` and legacy `placementHistory/1794182400000 = {i:long_voyage,p:1,s:1}`. `tr_horizon` has not been placed. The previous global lock was therefore incorrect: the player must be allowed to press Turkey Horizon immediately, even though Long Voyage was stamped this week.

## Exact changes — same existing Passport feature and QA files

- `AtlasBoardPassportFeature.cs`: read both original week-only receipts and the new independent per-stamp receipts; preserve existing read-only page snapshots and account isolation. Each new action writes an immutable ETag receipt to `users/{uid}/atlasPassport/placementHistory/{weekStartMs}/{stampId}/{p|r}`. The child `p` means press; `r` means remove. Per-stamp checks replace `ActionUsedThisWeek()` throughout button confirmation, writes and status text. # AtlasBoard v5.49.12dj — WEEKLY MISSION REWARDS & 312-WEEK CALENDAR — SOURCE PREPARED / OWNER QA PENDING

**Owner request (2026-11-10):** Four authentic weekly objectives should always motivate play. Each week has exactly three XP rewards and one spendable Gold reward, regardless of whether the global ~25%-chance cosmetic token is present. Every completed objective may be collected with the ONE `ÖDÜLLERİ AL` button. A collected reward gets a graphical green check immediately after its actual canonical wallet payout; pressing the button repeatedly cannot pay twice. No "No token this week" banner. Token is a bonus surprise. Retain Profile as the only entry (no Store weekly tab). ## Implementation contract

- **Actual same-UID signed proof:** `careerClaims/<uid>/<matchId>` has already been verified by the existing witnessed final-match rules. Objective definition for s0 rounds, s1 win/tie, s2 dice rolls, s3 properties remains exactly operator-published `weeklyMissionCatalog/<weekId>/variants/<UID-variant>/<slot>`.
- **Operator-owned immutable reward amounts:** `weeklyRewardCatalog/<weekId>/s0..s3`, with s0-s2 `kind=xp`, s3 `kind=gold`; amounts vary by week, deterministic after publication. No client-provided random awards. Separate reward catalog from token week schedule, which must NOT change after acceptance.
- **Create-only verified receipt:** `users/<uid>/weeklyRewardReceipts/<weekId>s<slot>` contains weekId, slot, signed matchId, exact catalog kind+amount and server-validated `claimedAt`. Rules reject another UID, fabricated claim, expired-match proof, arbitrary amount/kind and duplicate writes.
- **Canonical wallet settlement:** new `AtlasBoardWeeklyRewardWallet.cs` uses authenticated ETag GET / PUT to the *existing* `users/<uid>/metaEconomy`. The existing MATCH_REWARD rule branch's exhaustive inventory/equipped/daily/dev invariants are reused, with a new `WEEKLY_REWARD` alternative requiring the exact receipt. XP increments the EXISTING `promoXp` (which Career already adds to level); Gold increments the EXISTING `wallet.gold` (same spendable Shop balance). Append-only `rewardHistory` marker `|<weekId>s<slot>|` ensures irreversible one-time payment even across network loss and concurrent devices. Never increment local XP/Gold as a substitute for the server.
- **Acceptance gate:** wallet rule predicates include exact Gold/XP arithmetic, no extra inventory mutation, existing coin fields unchanged and unchanged `worldClaims` for WEEKLY_REWARD; the new Auth+RTDB emulator test must prove normal paid credits and reject attempts to mint bonus Gold/XP, steal other UID, tamper inventory, edit receipts or double credit. Do NOT deploy based on source-only tests.
- **Source of green check:** only the canonical ledger after server-accepted wallet operation, NOT an uncredited receipt. Per-task retry can recover after a receipt write but failed credit. One button collects any currently completed and unpaid tasks. All four + rare token week: original one-time cosmetic claim is attempted as EXTRA after standard payouts.
- **Weekly schedule**: first 156 previously published `weeklyMissionCatalog_initial.json` untouched. Separate `weeklyMissionCatalog_extension.json` appends 156 nonoverlapping weeks, ending 2032-10-31 UTC. Separate `collectibleTokenCatalog_extension.json` provides the new token definitions. `weeklyRewardCatalog_initial.json` covers 312 weeks. The publisher must use `database:update` (merge children), never `database:set` over these directories. Source generator does NOT publish.
- **Timekeeping**: Monday UTC source of truth; no per-player reroll. If a week is absent, fail closed with proper localized no-missions message; never fabricate weekly objectives/rewards. Historical verified claims in the active week count, even if Profile first opens after those matches. Filtering checks entire history but retains bounded current-week evidence, not arbitrary first 600 sorted GUIDs.
- **UI**: four original Profile rows show +XP or +Gold rewards, a graphical green check after paid beside 1/1, one `ÖDÜLLERİ AL` button, `YENİLE`, remaining UTC week time, and no negative token-week announcement; General Profile previews remain shared. On payout refresh original Career Bridge so Profile and Career level stay equivalent.
- **No duplicates**: no second Account, Store, Wallet, Economy or Career manager. No Firestore/Functions/Blaze; Spark RTDB only. Existing NEWS, Community Voting, World Journey and login/Profile OWNER PASS history unchanged.

**OWNER DECISION:** Weekly Missions implementation requested after `v5.49.12dg` was committed to GitHub (`fa4b4c3646ef9284a42de247b2bdc48a922ae7ea`). The owner accepted the `dg` Profile/Login UX changes as **OWNER PASS**. Existing NEWS, Community Voting, World Journey extra QA and prior Result-X acceptance remain **OWNER PASS / CLOSED**. **CURRENT STATUS: SOURCE IMPLEMENTED, SECURITY QA PENDING.** Added two Unity runtime scripts, existing Profile screen integration, one exact Store Weekly Missions navigation shortcut, operator-only 156-week schedule, 256-KiB-safe Rules preparation, source QA and official Auth+RTDB emulator QA. **Do not mark rewards OWNER PASS until official emulator tests + Unity two-UID live tests complete.** Source checks are not emulator tests. Spark RTDB only; no Functions/Blaze/Firestore or wallet mutation.

**Canonical design and storage:** Four user-scoped weekly objectives. Week IDs are UTC Monday dates `yyyyMMdd` and the active window is Monday 00:00 UTC through next Monday 00:00 UTC, enforced independently by Security Rules `now` and immutable operator-published `/weeklyMissionCatalog/{weekId}`. Account assignment path `/users/{uid}/weeklyMissions/{weekId}/assignment` is created only once using Firebase server timestamp and enforced UID-variant `a|b|c|d` (four different prepublished challenge mixes rotated across weeks; NOT device-random or rerollable). `lastSeenServerAt` is updated with RTDB server time only upon meaningful Profile/Store refresh, never every frame. Assignment target/proofs are client read-only; progress is always **derived from original, signed `/careerClaims/{uid}/{matchId}`**, with no mutable user-controlled XP/Gold/progress counters. Four challenge types: verified online match with minimum rounds, verified win or win/tie, minimum dice rolls in one signed match, minimum end-match properties. All four are independently validated. Per-mission visible progress `0/1` or `1/1`, computed from match-specific eligibility and bounded UTC timestamp; a single legitimate signed match may satisfy multiple independent criteria. No unproven rent/rematch/emote telemetry is counted.

**Global rarity:** Operator generated a committed 156-week (three-year) read-only manifest ONCE using a cryptographic 1-in-4 draw per global calendar week (`Backend/Firebase/weeklyMissionCatalog_initial.json` and `collectibleTokenCatalog_initial.json`). The per-week flag is shared by all players, and changing devices/accounts cannot reroll it. No Gold/XP fallback on no-token weeks. Future calendar years require publishing the next operator schedule after expiry, without overwriting past schedule. Calendar generation refuses overwrite. Current seed (2026-11-09) has no token reward; 2026-11-16 is marked a token week. Do not fabricate a claim during non-token weeks.

**Operator schedule fingerprint (frozen catalog):** `weeklyMissionCatalog_initial.json` SHA-256 `1be4196f6ec02334d1b4c9ae4cdafaa5a67768360335f3cace3e0029548d7141`; 156 published decisions must use these exact bytes. Re-run of generator deliberately refuses to overwrite the file. This fingerprint makes accidental/repeated lottery rerolls detectable.

**Reward security:** On token weeks only, pressing `JETONU AL` before server-validated UTC week end creates immutable `/users/{uid}/weeklyMissions/{weekId}/claim` once. The RTDB Rules recheck existence, ownership UID, weekly timestamp and all **four matching original signed Career receipts** using manifest-protected criteria. Client cannot forge `allCompleted`, token ID, claim timestamp, negative Gold delta or foreign-UID claim. A second create-only, claim-authorized `/users/{uid}/collectibleTokens/{tokenId}` grant permanently records the cosmetic; interrupted claim→inventory publishing is idempotently retried next load. No Gold, Atlas Coin, XP, purchase, daily reward, World Journey claim or other inventory is touched. Detailed Museum equip/3-slot owned-token UI remains NEXT PHASE (not silently claimed as complete).

**UI:** Existing Career+Settings full-screen Profile routes and XP/Level stay intact. The four General Profile preview rows and detailed Weekly Missions tab now read one shared verified model; show mission descriptions, 0/1 progress bars, UTC countdown, optional token-week hint, explicit claim and refresh buttons. Mission objectives have 7-locale labels. Account switch invalidates previous UID model and discards late async results; other player records are never queried. ## Weekly Missions and collectible backend contract — retained requirements, clarified by approval

- Initial feature = **four independent, UID-specific weekly missions**. Canonical period is **Monday 00:00 UTC to next Monday 00:00 UTC**, determined and enforced by RTDB Rules / server-trusted time; per-account assignment persists under **`/users/{uid}/weeklyMissions/{weekId}`**. New week gets a new record; old records are preserved, not overwritten. Do not derive entitlements from local clock or PlayerPrefs.
- Mission progress must be derived only from **eligible verified human-online Career match proof** with **unique match-ID deduplication**. The exported RTDB snapshot contains `/careerClaims`, `/careerAttestations`, `/careerFinalProofs` and `/careerDiceObservations`; inspect the actual fields/proof/rules before choosing eligible mission templates. **Win / completed game / dice-roll / match-level property counts** may be possible when signed proof supports them; **per-rent receipts, rematch events and emote usage shown in the concept art cannot be rewarded without a separately verified authoritative event source**. No fake score or client-submitted progress.
- **One globally scheduled ~25% token-bearing week** (operator-controlled server-published manifest), **not a per-player 25% reward roll**. During a token week, each player must finish all **four** own missions and press **`JETONU AL`** before the confirmed expiry to receive one permanent collectible token with a once-only validated claim receipt; non-token weeks grant no invented Gold/XP fallback. The final missed-claim expiry behavior remains the earlier proposed end-of-week deadline until owner revises.
- Proposed catalog `/weeklyMissionCatalog/{weekId}`, token catalog and verified ownership/loadout must fit Spark RTDB Security Rules and existing economy/inventory. **Critical feasibility/security gate remains OPEN**: RTDB Spark has no trusted server random assignment; determine and emulator-verify tamper-resistant UID-specific assignment and reward claim without Cloud Functions or client RNG. Reward system must not launch in insecure client-authoritative mode. Keep account-switch cache isolation, per-UID ownership, no cross-UID claims, reconnect/retry idempotence, and no spendable Gold/XP writes from purely equipping showcase tokens.
- `ATLAS MÜZESİ` tab: an owned-token list/picker and 3-slot equip/replace/remove actions, account-persistent UID-scoped verified loadout, ownership checks, hover/tap info. **Phase 1 uses generic tokens**; later phase can introduce special art and detailed tooltip graphics. Missing token ownership renders empty slots rather than seeded default owned items. Do not create public token profile exposure without later consent/privacy review.

## Implementation sequence, scope and gates

1. **Phase DB-1 — Profile UI shell**: audit existing Career Profile, Settings account popup, Steam account popup and RTDB profile resolver; implement *one* reusable profile route, first-letter monogram, real `playerId`, level/XP, read-only account info, and verified Steam link status. Match the accepted blue/purple/gold layout and context-aware back navigation. No separate menu manager.
2. **Phase DB-2 — Overview + tabs**: functional General Profile and four left tabs; 4-row Weekly preview, exactly-three-slot Museum preview, Passport booklet teaser; no invented data. Preserve existing Store Weekly Missions entry contract and keep a shared state model.
3. **Phase DB-3 — Secure Weekly Missions**: server-validated UTC week and per-UID assignment, signed proof aggregation, operator-controlled token-week catalog, secure manual once-only claim, full official Auth+RTDB emulator abuse tests and Unity real two-client QA. Do **not** grant collectibles until this gate succeeds.

# AtlasBoard v5.49.12cx — Community Voting RTDB Rules API Correction and Immutable Anonymous Aggregation (2026-11-10)

**STATUS: SOURCE PREPARED / EMULATOR OWNER QA PENDING.** This checkpoint supersedes the prior v5.49.12cw proposed client-writable tally design **only for Community Voting**, retains all preceding roadmap history unchanged, and preserves NEWS owner-accepted visuals and the 20 bundled news posts. No production deploy, remote database import, GitHub push, wallet mutation, account migration or Unity build was performed by the assistant. Game-facing version remains `v0.9.0-beta.1`.

## Owner's exact error and verified cause

- Owner Unity compilation for the previous package: **NO ERRORS REPORTED** (previous `cw`/`cv` installed source, not a new compile acceptance for this `cx` file).
- Previous source structural suite: **24/24 PASS**. This was not an Auth+RTDB emulator result.
- Owner's second Firebase emulator run failed during RTDB Rules loading with three `No such method/property 'numChildren'` errors at positions `1:252523`, `1:253465`, `1:256029` in a minified ~256 KiB `database.rules.json`. Firebase **RuleDataSnapshot** in Security Rules does not expose `numChildren()` even though the Firebase SDK **DataSnapshot** class does; therefore the three expressions could never compile. A syntactic removal alone would also weaken the earlier append-only marker proof because `.validate` is not evaluated for deletions. **Do not deploy the old cw rules.**

## cx safe correction: one poll / seven direct answer choices, actual RTDB persistence

- Keep the exact **one poll with seven choices** (`maps`, `pawns`, `avatars`, `dice`, `boards`, `profile_frames`, `emotes`) and its existing operator-published manifest `/communityPolls/community_feature_priority_2026w46`. NEWS button, Help/Credits internal tabs, twenty dated articles, twenty-month cutoff, UI shell and event/Store/gameplay remain unchanged.
- `/communityVotes/{pollId}/{auth.uid}` is a **PRIVATE, immutable** registered-UID vote receipt with approved `optionId`, authoritative `createdAt` via RTDB ServerValue.TIMESTAMP, and a one-time random 32-character `publicAlias`. Cross-account reads/writes, duplicate submissions, anonymous voting, extra fields, invalid options and out-of-window new votes are denied by RTDB Rules.
- `/communityPublicVotes/{pollId}/{publicAlias}` contains **only `{optionId}`**; its only authorized creator is the exact UID whose already-saved immutable private receipt names both the alias and option. Creation is once-only; mutation and deletion are denied. No UID, nickname, account balance or private transaction metadata appears in this public branch. A saved private receipt may be published/retried after the poll closes to recover from a network interruption, but no new private vote may be created after its server-UTC deadline.
- Public total and per-option numbers are **computed by the game from authenticated read-only public pseudonymous receipts**; there are **no player-writable total/option counters** and no `countedUids` array to tamper with. All seven options are counted, unknown/malformed public entries ignored, and an unavailable/unverified read is never reported as a fabricated zero. The game refreshes while the panel is open; this simple approach is suitable for early rollout but **is O(number of published votes)** in download and must be reconsidered for large populations. Alias keys are pseudonymous and publicly enumerable to authenticated users; there is no UID mapping exposed, but they are not equivalent to a cryptographically secret ballot.
- The existing operator audit tool now compares private receipts against anonymous public records, **read-only by default**. A deliberately authorized admin repair can add **missing** validated aliases without overwriting an active tally; it never writes user wallets or changes vote choices. The client itself also retries publication when reopening a saved vote. No Cloud Functions, Blaze, Firestore, separate wallet or paid scheduler was introduced.

## Local rules migration, tests and deployment boundary

- The existing `Backend/Firebase/qa/phase19cu_news_voting_prepare_rules.cjs` replaces exactly the previously generated cw/cv voting branches when they match known fingerprints (including operator-minified current cw). RTDB Rules bind exact Auth UID, registered `general.accountType`, time window using trusted `now`, present approved option ID, immutable create-only receipt. Cross-UID writes, anonymous votes, second votes, unauthorized options and expired submissions are rejected by Rules. A restarted client reads only its own saved receipt, not the full voter ledger. Never trust local nickname, device time or PlayerPrefs for eligibility.
- **Privacy-preserving server counters:** `/communityVoteTallies/{pollId}/total` (authenticated read) and `/communityVoteTallies/{pollId}/optionCounts/{optionId}` (authenticated read) store the actual server-counted totals. `/communityVoteTallies/{pollId}/countedUids/{uid}` is **unreadable by other players**. After a valid immutable receipt, the client makes a **single multi-path RTDB PATCH** using `ServerValue.increment(1)` for the total and exactly the selected option, plus its own once-only counted marker. Proposed Security Rules grant this only if an existing valid own vote receipt is present, the marker is absent, exactly one marker is added and each of the seven option count deltas matches the receipt. Repeated tally writes/forged increments and counter tampering must fail. UI refreshes only public aggregates periodically; `—` is shown until a verified server value is read, and 0 is only shown after a successful server read of empty counter data.
- **Network-failure recovery:** If the vote receipt is committed but the tally update is interrupted, the next open tries to tally that *same* saved vote; already-counted attempts are denied harmlessly. The optional existing administrator audit script now checks the one poll, verifies its UID receipts and can repair verified totals with explicit authenticated operator intent. No cloud function, paid scheduler, plaintext admin key, client-readable UID roster or fake count is introduced. Before owner two-client/live tests, **do not report perfectly real-time or perfectly reconciled totals as accepted**; Spark clients can disconnect between the two independent operations, so reconciliation is best effort or operator audited.
- **Local rules generator (existing tool updated):** `Backend/Firebase/qa/phase19cu_news_voting_prepare_rules.cjs` accepts a byte-verified `ct` original rules file or a recognized previously prepared `cu` rules layout, fails closed on unknown rules or existing new counter branch, preserves unrelated rule trees and original wallet/history rules, and generates a complete local `Backend/Firebase/database.rules.json` only with `--write` after creating a non-overwriting backup in the Windows user home folder outside the Git repository. Since that baseline is a **huge existing source (about 261 KiB)** and is not supplied directly in the small overlay ZIP, do **not** replace the full canonical Rules document with a truncated or synthetic copy. Generated size is checked below 256 KiB by whitespace-only normalization. This is a local operation, **not a Firebase deploy**. Before installation, ensure the owner's current local rules are the actual checked source; never overwrite newer or unknown rules.

## 1. Feature A — Weekly Missions / Haftalık Görevler (P1, owner-requested)

### Player-facing behavior

- Every **verified Firebase Auth UID** receives an **account-specific weekly mission set**. Initial design: **four missions per week**, sampled/assigned from a controlled template pool with varied objectives and thresholds, rather than showing everybody the same fixed four rows. Proposed eligible templates reuse *existing authenticated, accepted Career match proof* fields wherever possible: completed online matches, wins, gameplay dice rolls, developments, turns, distinct maps, and achieved end-match net worth. Verify exact source proof/field availability before using any template. Bots/offline-only matches and fabricated client progress must not count as signed competitive mission proof.
- Canonical week window: **Monday 00:00:00 UTC inclusive through next Monday 00:00:00 UTC exclusive**; use stable week ID such as `2026-W46`, derived from the **server UTC date**, not PC date, time zone or PlayerPrefs. Display the user's localized date/time equivalent but evaluate mission boundaries in UTC. All missions in the same weekly assignment use the same `[startUtcMs, endUtcMs)` range; a match/proof outside it never increments that week.
- When a user logs in and when Store > Weekly Missions is opened/resumed, refresh the account's **server-validated current timestamp** and compare it with saved weekly start/end. Update that account's `lastSeenServerAt` with a *true RTDB server timestamp*, not arbitrary client milliseconds. If the server week is outside the saved interval, **initialize a new week assignment under a new week ID**; the expired week remains immutable/readable as history, not overwritten. If the same valid week remains active, load it unchanged; repeated login/restart cannot reroll missions. When offline or timestamp validation fails, display last verified data as stale/read-only and do not claim, reroll or grant rewards. Avoid continuous write-every-frame/heartbeat; refresh at login and meaningful navigation/reconnect.
- Mission rows show objective, `N/target`, progress bar and `Devam ediyor` / `Tamamlandı` state, plus visible start/end countdown based on server-verified time. Every achievement counts once per accepted unique match ID and owner UID; no repeated reward from rematch/rejoin/reconnect/retry. Completion means **all four** assigned missions have individually reached targets; partial completion **never** permits claiming a weekly token.
- **Rare token-week schedule:** approximately **25% independent chance per calendar week** that the *week itself* contains a collectible-token reward. This chance is applied **once globally when the authoritative weekly schedule is published**, NOT on every login, claim click, account or task; the week cannot be rerolled by changing device/date/reinstalling. Therefore on a token week, all eligible players have an equal opportunity to earn that week's featured collectible by completing *their own four missions*. In a non-token week, weekly missions remain visible/playable, but **no museum token can be claimed**. Do not falsely show an award or invent a Gold/XP/Atlas Coin fallback without a separate owner decision. A 25% probability is a long-run expectation, **not** an exact guarantee of one token every fourth week.
- On a token week, completion changes token status to `ÖDÜL ALINABİLİR`; the player explicitly taps **`JETONU AL`** to claim. Claim is **once per UID, weekId, tokenId** with visible result/receipt; repeated tap, simultaneous clients and retry cannot duplicate ownership. Do not auto-claim. Once the time window expires, new progression/claims are blocked; a completed-but-unclaimed reward expiry policy must be set explicitly before implementation. **Proposed initial rule:** claim before the week's UTC end; show the deadline prominently to prevent surprise. Never silently compensate a missed token with Gold.
- Tokens are **permanent, round, collectible cosmetic items** with unique stable ID, localized name, description, theme, earned-week/date and artwork. No purchase/sale, currency conversion or tradable/transferable item behavior in this scope. Maintain inventory after the weekly cycle ends and after account sign-in on another device. Curated seasonal token IDs must avoid unintended repeated grants of the same token; unique weekly editions can be catalogued individually.

### RTDB data and authority contract (proposed schema; implementation requires inspecting current rules)

- Required per-user branch: **`/users/{uid}/weeklyMissions`** (owner specifically requested this, not a top-level parallel user database). Suggested record path `/users/{uid}/weeklyMissions/{weekId}` with immutable `weekId`, `startUtcMs`, `endUtcMs`, `assignmentVersion`, `assignedMissionIds[4]`, each objective's target/progress/proof cursor, `missionStatus`, `allCompleted`, `tokenId` or null, `rewardStatus` (`not_offered|locked|claimable|claimed|expired`), `claimedAtServerMs`, `lastSeenServerAt`, `assignmentId` and append-only claim marker/receipt reference. A separate small `currentWeekId` view/pointer is optional if safe; full completed prior weeks must not be destroyed by rollover.
- Globally administered read-only schedule/catalog (example `/weeklyMissionCatalog/{weekId}` and `/collectibleTokenCatalog/{tokenId}`) defines week's exact UTC window, available mission templates/targets, week-level `hasTokenReward`, featured token ID and catalog/art. **Ordinary players cannot write or change the schedule, odds, token definitions or eligibility.** Reuse the existing canonical signed Career proof (`/careerClaims/{uid}/{matchId}`) and its deduplication contract, not a second fabricated match evidence system.
- **Critical Spark feasibility gate:** Firebase RTDB Security Rules do *not* automatically provide a trusted random-number draw or secure server-side mission assignment. Client-side `Random`, local seed or user-chosen four mission IDs **must never be accepted as authoritative entitlement**. Before writing reward code, choose and emulator-verify a workable **Spark + RTDB-only**, rule-verifiable per-UID assignment strategy (e.g., prepublished read-only weekly variants with rule-verified UID-dependent selection, or owner/admin-authorized provisioned per-UID manifests). Establish automatic onboarding for new eligible accounts if provisioning is used; no manually unscalable weekly player-by-player setup. Individualized, persistent missions and protected one-time claims are non-negotiable. If true unique-per-user assignments cannot be secured in Spark, raise the limitation for owner decision **instead of silently shipping client-trusted assignment**.
- The weekly global 25% reward-week choice is generated/published by the authorized operator (not a client); a reproducible audit record identifies the selection for the week. Establish how the schedule will be provisioned/updated without Blaze/Functions, and require explicit owner agreement for any external scheduled service or admin key use. Neither `ServerValue.TIMESTAMP` by itself nor `.info/serverTimeOffset` is authorization; RTDB Rules `now` and validated proofs/claims must enforce week boundaries and write permissions.
- Atomic/idempotent claim should use an ETag transaction and Security Rules to assert exact UID, matching authoritative week manifest, signed proof-based completion, once-only marker and newly-created inventory entitlement. Integrate token ownership into the already canonical UID-scoped inventory/entitlement architecture **without** a second wallet, mutable client-asserted `allCompleted`, or bypassing Shop purchase/DAILY/World Journey constraints. If existing inventory schema disallows a new `tokens` category, plan a narrowly validated extension plus official emulator negative tests, not a blind root rewrite.
- Proposed account record shape for implementation discussion (not live data, not permission to write):

```text
/users/{uid}/weeklyMissions/{weekId}
  startUtcMs, endUtcMs, lastSeenServerAt
  assignmentVersion, assignmentId
  missions/{missionId}: { target, verifiedProgress, status }
  allCompleted, rewardStatus, tokenId
  claimedAtServerMs, claimReceiptId
/users/{uid}/collectibleTokens/{tokenId}: { acquiredWeekId, acquiredAtServerMs, sourceReceiptId }
/weeklyMissionCatalog/{weekId}: { startUtcMs, endUtcMs, hasTokenReward, featuredTokenId, ... }
```

`collectibleTokens` is a proposed **ownership index**, not a second spendable balance. Final paths and transaction layout must be reconciled with the current RTDB `metaEconomy.inventory` ETag rules and actual Career source before implementation; do not create competing authoritative owned-item stores.

## 2. Feature B — Atlas Museum / 3-slot collectible showcase (P1, owner-requested)

- **Museum is a Career Profile capability**, not a new Main Menu tile or standalone scene. Under the existing avatar, display **three equally sized circular token positions**, aesthetically aligned with the existing Career/Profile card. No more than **3 equipped** tokens; **0, 1 or 2** are valid. Empty positions show quiet `+`/placeholder rings. This three-token maximum is independent of the existing **six-active-emotes** system and must not change emote limits.

Slot order [0,1,2] is stable across launches and platforms. Persist only verified current UID's loadout under a purpose-specific branch, e.g. `/users/{uid}/museumLoadout` or a validated extension of canonical equipment (final location decided after source review). Reject `>3`, duplicate, unowned and cross-account writes in Rules.
- On PC, **mouse hover** on a round badge displays a tooltip with localized **token title, description, date/week earned and collection rarity**. On Android/touch, a **tap/long press** provides the identical information; do not rely on hover-only UX. Keyboard/gamepad focus may reuse the same panel where supported. The tooltip is visually on top and cannot be clipped by the avatar or popup boundaries.
- `Atlas Müzesi` selector displays owned and optionally locked catalog entries without leaking private account data. Locked entries cannot be equipped; provide an explanation such as `Haftalık görev koleksiyonu`. Existing avatar/profile-frame equipment stays unchanged. No Gold/XP/Atlas Coin delta for equip/unequip, and no purchase/claim history mutation from purely changing showcase slots.
- If featured on another player's public profile in the future, expose only **three safe public token IDs** through the existing allowed public-profile projection, not their full private mission history. Cross-user public display is **optional/later**, not a hidden requirement for initial release.

## 3. Feature C — NEWS / HABERLER and Community Voting (P1, owner-requested)

### Main Menu / News UI

- Preserve existing Help/Credits popup style as reference: centered dark-navy rounded card, subtle gold top stroke, tab pills, readable typography, close X and KAPAT, dimmed backdrop, vertical scroll with touch support. A new `NEWS` Main Menu button opens **two internal tabs**: **`HABERLER`** and **`TOPLULUK OYLAMASI`**. The main Help button continues opening its current **Help** and **Credits/Licenses** internal tabs. One popup at a time; do not leave modal raycast blockers over active gameplay or create double buttons after scene navigation.
- `HABERLER`: published, newest-first news/release notices/event announcements with title, body, publish date and optional simple picture/link if later approved. Empty/loading/error/ended states; no user-created news. Admin-controlled read-only publication with server times, small pagination and limited image load for Android. Do not claim to have published actual news content in this roadmap phase.

### Exactly seven voting categories

1. **HARİTALAR / MAPS** — future map themes/candidates.
2. **PİYONLAR / PAWNS** — future pawn models.
3. **PROFİL FOTOĞRAFI / AVATARS** — pre-approved avatar-art choices (not user-uploaded photographs in v1).
4. **ZARLAR / DICE** — future dice styles.
5. **TAHTALAR / BOARDS** — board cosmetic themes.
6. **PROFİL ÇERÇEVELERİ / PROFILE FRAMES** — future frame designs.
7. **EMOTE / EMOTES** — future emote designs.

Each category can display an **active poll** with a short question, 2–4 **administrator-defined** options and clear visual/description. Users vote by selecting a candidate and pressing `OY VER`. Require valid authenticated exact UID; account guests' voting eligibility must be an explicit rules-backed product decision before implementation (**proposed: verified registered users only**, to reduce anonymous re-voting). **One accepted vote per UID per poll ID**; no per-click or repeat Gold/XP, no client-supplied tally. UI displays `OYUN KAYDEDİLDİ`, disables further voting for that poll, and survives device restart. Ended polls become read-only and can show verified published results. Never promise the most-voted choice will automatically be developed; results inform owner's roadmap choice.

**RTDB:** operator-owned `/newsPosts/{postId}` and `/communityPolls/{pollId}` definitions, a UID-bound immutable vote receipt such as `/communityVotes/{pollId}/{uid}` or `/users/{uid}/communityVotes/{pollId}`, and a separately **trusted published aggregate** for public result counts. Clients may create **only their own valid one-vote record within server UTC start/end**, with an option ID present in the server-owned poll; they cannot edit/delete their vote, create polls, mint counts or vote under someone else's UID. A malicious client must not write global `voteCount`. The initial results screen may show `Sonuçlar oylama bitince yayınlanacak` until an authoritative aggregate is produced; never sum other players' private vote records in every client if that exposes UIDs or increases download costs. Plan a safe admin result-publication workflow consistent with Spark + RTDB without Cloud Functions/Firestore. Prefer no photo upload, open comments, chat or uncontrolled external link until moderation/privacy work is explicitly accepted.

## 4. Feature D — Atlas Passport / Atlas Pasaport (P1/P2 UI experience, owner-requested)

- Open Passport **from Career Profile** through an `ATLAS PASAPORT` action (not a new sixth Main Menu tile). Make the interface visually resemble a **real physical travel passport**: closed booklet cover/embossed gold atlas mark; click → **short, fluid book-opening animation** revealing facing pages, light paper texture, travel stamp positions, country titles, collectible ink shapes. Use Unity UI / efficient animation to avoid a costly full 3D book, excessive particles or degraded Galaxy S20 FE FPS. X/back closes to the existing Career profile without losing account or scroll state.
- **At least 10 unique stamp designs available at launch**; not ten identical icons with changed title. Initial proposed catalog of ten: `Türkiye Yolcusu`, `Colorado Kaşifi`, `ABD Rotası`, `Almanya Damgası`, `Meksika Damgası` (earned from an accepted online completed match on the corresponding existing map); `İlk Yolculuk` (first verified online match), `İlk Zafer` (first verified online win), `Tecrübeli Gezgin` (five accepted online matches), `Üç Harita Gezgini` (three distinct accepted online map IDs), `Dünya Turu` (ten accepted online matches). Final localization/visual names may be refined. The existing `World` map can later provide an **additional** event-exclusive stamp; do not make the basic ten require an expired World Journey unlock.
- Stamp eligibility must be read from **existing authoritative Career claims and unique match IDs**, not local date, UI clicks, visual ownership of a map or fabricated statistics. A stamp is initially displayed as **earned but not yet inked** once all conditions are verified. When eligible, press **`DAMGA BAS`** on a passport page: an ink stamp handle/graphic drops, produces one small tactile `tak` sound (properly licensed/original), and the stamp **appears on paper permanently** with a brief imprint effect. Do not autoplay a stamp merely because a match ended. If the player cancels without claiming, eligibility remains. Respect audio settings and accessibility/reduced-motion where available; allow skipping the animation while still showing persisted result.
- Backend claim must commit **once per UID + stampId**, with receipt and server-issued timestamp. Animation plays **after acknowledged successful claim**, or simply shows already-stamped state on reconnect/reopen; if network fails, no fake permanent stamp. On retry/two-device concurrency, at most one actual stamp ownership record is created. A failed cosmetic animation must never undo a committed stamp, and a visually stamped page must reflect the true persisted state.
- Proposed UID record `/users/{uid}/atlasPassport/stamps/{stampId}` holding canonical `acquiredAtServerMs`, `sourceProofId`/qualified verified milestone, and `claimReceiptId`. A read-only `/passportStampCatalog/{stampId}` defines requirements and art. Existing passport records and map progress remain untouched when weekly missions roll over. Account A→B or Guest→registered uses the same canonical UID gating; never display A's stamp book for B.
- Passport **stamps and Museum jetons are two distinct collectible types**. Stamps live on passport pages and have a button-driven imprint effect; jetons are circular equipable profile showcase items earned from token-awarding weekly mission cycles. They should not share equip slots, receipts, names or claim authority by accident.

## 5. Cross-feature authority, economy and performance decisions

- **Authoritative state:** all user progress, weekly assignments, token awards, equipped museum slots, poll receipts and passport claims belong to **exact Firebase Auth UID**; never associate rewards by nickname/Steam persona alone. Same-UID Guest→registered transition preserves all data; account switch invalidates active Career/Store/News/Passport caches and drops stale async responses. No `users` root migration, no wallet duplication, no client-owned Gold/XP/Atlas Coin mutation. Previously accepted `PURCHASE`, `DAILY`, `DEV_GRANT`, Promo, Event/World Journey, Store History, Emote, host migration, Rematch and result-X flows are unchanged.
- **Hosting/financial constraints:** Firebase **Spark/free, RTDB first**, no new Firestore, Cloud Functions/Blaze requirement, external paid random generator, proprietary scheduler or automatic production deploy. Any operator-seeding script or scheduled external admin publisher is an explicit design proposal requiring owner approval and secret-safe operation. Source inspection and **actual Firebase Auth+RTDB Emulator** permission tests precede any new Rules deployment. Security Rules current size ceiling, ETag contention, existing `metaEconomy` schema validation and RTDB quota must be evaluated.
- **Evidence only:** signed/accepted Career match completions, UID participation and unique `matchId` are the trusted source for weekly/passport milestones. Verify each proposed template/stamp condition has genuine record fields; never create new false match claims or count Editor QA shortcuts as live-online evidence. The existing 2026-11-03 to 2027-06-30 World Journey event is separate; new weekly reset **must not** reset or change its season progress/reward history.
- **Server UTC:** week start/end, last-seen/claim timestamps, vote windows and news publication use server-authoritative time. No reliance on Windows/Android device time, locale, daylight saving, manual time change or Unity `DateTime.Now` for eligibility. UTC display can be localized but must never decide award validity.
- **7 supported locales:** `TR`, `EN`, `ES`, `FR`, `DE`, `KO`, `RU`; real translated labels/help/stamp names/descriptions, not hard-coded strings with a single language. Preserve TMP fallback and text wrapping. Mouse hover must have touch/keyboard alternative. 1920×1080, 1280×720, Android phone/tablet aspect ratios, modal open/close/scroll and safe areas must be visually verified.
- **Performance:** no repeated rebuilding of Store/Career panels on polling, no expensive per-frame network reads or full `/users` scans. Fetch only needed per-UID branches and bounded public news/poll cards; cache art and animate UI sparingly. Sustained Galaxy S20 FE FPS/thermal is still an open release gate. No game-scene camera/turn/auction remakes for these meta-only features.

# AtlasBoard v5.49.12cj — Single RTDB Promo Catalog, Live Event Claim Path and UI/FAQ Closure (2026-11-03)

**DELIVERY: COMPLETE SOURCE FILES, TEST/DEPLOY GATES STILL OPEN.** This section supersedes older `serverPromoCodes`, old Node seeding script and progress-display text. All prior roadmap history and owner-accepted systems remain unchanged. GitHub main was not pushed, no production RTDB value was written, and no live Cloud Functions were deployed by this package.

## Canonical backend (no Spark / Firestore for live event or promo rewards)

- One global administrative catalog: **`/promoCodes/{NORMALIZED_CODE}`**. Each record includes its literal `code`, `schemaVersion: 2`, `active`, `scope` (`owner_qa` or `public`), `quantity`, `reward` (`type`, `amount`, optionally `itemId`/`itemType`), `startsAtEpochMs`, `endsAtEpochMs`, `createdAt` and `perAccountLimit: 1` as a descriptive contract. `quantity` must exactly match reward amount; non-stackable items require `quantity: 1`. Ordinary clients have **zero read/write access** to this root. The existing authenticated Functions callable does the lookup and server-side account grant.
- Existing **`/users/{uid}/promoRedemptions/{sha256}`** records the exact normalized code, reward type/amount/item, timestamp, status, source and deterministic transaction ID; the same-UID record is checked before and inside the account transaction. Existing purchase receipts, Meta History and paid entitlements are not replaced.
- Existing **`/users/{uid}/seasonalEvents/world_journey_2027_s1`** records eight mission progress counters and claimed reward history with transaction IDs and claim times. Existing **`/users/{uid}/seasonalRewards/xp`** provides Career-visible bonus XP, separate from verified match claims. World map ownership and exclusive board entitlement use the existing `metaEconomy.inventory` booleans. Authoritative mission progress comes only from verified `/careerClaims/{uid}/{matchId}`; an offline bot match does not count.
- Event timing remains **Nov 3 2026 00:00 UTC to Jun 30 2027 23:59:59.999 UTC**. Rewards never auto-claim: each of the first seven must be claimed in the Rewards tab, then the eighth claim grants **World Map** (`map_world`, in-game display name still **World**). Explicitly claiming all eight allows the separate **Atlas Horizon Board** (`board_atlas_horizon`). Both exclusive rewards remain non-sellable and cannot be granted by any promo code.

## Canlı dağıtım/yayın öncesi değiştirilmeyecek güvenlik kapıları

1. **Node/Firebase build + RTDB emulator**: yeni callable'ların gerçek Auth JWT, AppCheck, tarih, UID, idempotency, güvenlik kuralı ve cüzdan/XP/receipt regresyonu PASS olmalı.
2. **Unity 6000.5.6f1 compile + iki istemci**: World haritası 32 kare, offline ve private/public host map seçimi, bir sonraki sahne/yeniden giriş, bonus board gerçek görünüm, Event dört alt sayfa ve 7 lokalizasyon PASS olmalı.
3. **Production deploy** ancak açık kullanıcı onayı ve Blaze/Functions bütçesi, secret yönetimi ve release gate sonrası. Bu pakette `firebase deploy`, promo seed veya GitHub push yapılmadı.
4. **Server Version Gate** önceki karara göre ertelendi; Steam UID, hesap geçişi ve career dice online acceptance ayrı P0 kapıları açık, önceki owner-PASS emote/rejoin/local rematch tekrar açılmadı.

## 2. Kod Kullan / promosyon kodları: mevcut sistemin gerçek durumu — P1 OPEN

**Soru: Kodları nerede saklıyoruz?** Önceden oluşturulmuş **eski/emülatör odaklı** mimaride:
- Backend tanım ve doğrulama kodu: `Backend/Firebase/functions/src/economy/promo.ts`; normalleştirilen girilmiş kodun SHA-256 ID'si ile `Firestore /promo_codes/{promoId}` tanımı bulunur.
- Kullanım/audit kaydı: `Firestore /promo_redemptions/{redemptionId}` ve `events/{redemptionEventId}`; para ödülü için `wallets/{uid}/balances/{currencyId}` ile `wallet_ledger`; item grant için `inventories/{uid}/items/{itemId}` + immutable events; ürün kimliği/katalog `item_catalog/{itemId}`.
- Test seed kaynağı: `Backend/Firebase/functions/scripts/meta-storefront-seed.mjs`; örnek `ATLAS-WELCOME` / `DICE-GIFT` **DEV/EMULATOR fixture**, canlıda geçerli kod olduğu doğrulanmadı. Seed örneği `displayCode` alanını da yazabilir; bu üretim sırlarının güvenli saklandığı anlamına gelmez.
- Unity giriş ekranı: `Assets/Project/Scripts/UI/Meta/AtlasBoardMetaEconomyUI.cs` → `AtlasBoardMetaEconomyBridge.RedeemCodeAsync()` → `promoTestRedeem`.
- `Backend/Firebase/functions/src/index.ts` içindeki `promoTestRedeem` **`requireEmulatedFirestore`** çağırır: **yalnız emülatörde** çalışır; production redeem hazır değildir.
- Eski promo reward tipleri: `gold`, `atlas_coin`, `inventory_item`, `event_currency`, `event_ticket`; **kalıcı hesap XP tipi mevcut değil**.
- **Kritik veri modeli farkı:** Eski Firestore promo akışı ödülü Firestore `wallets` veya `inventories` verisine yazar. **Güncel canlı Store/owner kabulü RTDB** `users/{uid}/metaEconomy` üzerinde. Yalnız emulator engelini kaldırmak **YASAK**: canlı RTDB Store, Career ve satın alma geçmişinden kopuk para/ürün yaratma, farklı bakiye ve sahipsiz entitlement riski vardır. 3. **Kalıcı hesap XP:** 3 ayrı değer/kod ailesi: **50, 500, 5000 XP**. *Önce* mevcut Career XP otoritesine kayıtlı sunucu denetimli ödül/ledger entegrasyonu gerekli; istemci veya promo parser doğrudan XP yükseltemez. Maç sonuçlarının XP/Gold yetkisini değiştirme.

Owner: “Yerel maçta REMATCH ana menüye dönüyor pass”. İlgili kaynaklar: mevcut `AtlasBoardOfflineModeBootstrap.cs` ve `MatchResultManager.cs`. Bu kabul online rematch/host migration kapsamını yeniden açmaz.

İlgili kaynak: mevcut `AtlasBoardCanonicalProfileHeader.cs` UID-guard'lı read-only frame reconciliation. Satın alma, equipped, public-profile ve işlem geçmişi kayıtları değiştirilmedi.

Son bu üç QA sonucu ile bu alanlarda yeni başarısızlık raporu yoktur. Kaynak düzeyi v5.49.12cf statik gate `58/58 PASS`, ancak bu sonuç Unity derleme veya live Firebase/emulator kanıtı yerine geçmez. Owner'ın üç yeni manuel PASS sonucu ayrı, gerçek kabul kanıtıdır.

## Gerçekten açık kalan işler — yeni seçim sırası ve durum

- **P0 / ONLINE CAREER DICE CLOUD ACCEPTANCE — OPEN:** Farklı Firebase Auth UID'lerine sahip iki gerçek insanla özel online veya public online odada tamamlanmış, sunucunca kabul edilen maçta host ve follower'ın `diceRolls`, `totalDiceValue`, `highestRoll`, ortalama değerlerini ve `careerDiceObservations/<uid>/<matchId>` append-only kayıtlarını karşılaştır. UID isolation, re-login ve ikinci cihaz okuma testleri gerekli. Yerel botla `LocalOffline` modunda `cloud_rewards=false` olduğundan Career/Gold/XP kalıcı olmaz; bu beklenen durum, bug değildir. Sunucu tarafından zarın her atışını kanıtlama/authoritative aggregate hâlâ ayrı P1 güvenlik tasarımıdır.
- **P0 / STEAM TRUSTED IDENTITY & LEGACY WALLET RECOVERY — OPEN RELEASE GATE:** Retail Steam ticket server-side doğrulaması ve SteamID64 → kesin Firebase UID bağı; eski Vuartex sahipliği bulunan UID'nin isim eşitliğine dayanarak kopyalanmaması/merge edilmemesi. Steam A → B → A yeniden başlatmalarında doğru UID, Gold, satın alma, Career doğrulanmalı. QA'daki yerel Steam adının doğru görünmesi bu gate'i kapatmaz.
- **P0 / GUEST → REGISTERED IDENTITY + CACHE ISOLATION — OPEN BROAD ACCEPTANCE:** Guest kayıt olurken aynı UID ve eski owned items/Gold/Career korunmalı; Steam/REST hesap değiştirilince önceki UID'ye ait wallet/inventory/Career/header/async response görünmemeli. Source guards mevcut fakat tam iki hesap, cold restart, cross-screen kabul kanıtı ile release seviyesinde kapatılmadı. Rastgele hesapları Gold/XP/item aktarımıyla birleştirme yok.
- **P0/P1 / ACTIVE-MATCH REJOIN, HOST-MIGRATION & FINAL REWARDS — OPEN TARGETED LIVE QA:** Aktif maçta düşen oyuncunun gerçek UID ile seat'e yeniden katılması, host değişmesi, maçın tamamlanması; XP/Gold/achievement/history ve disconnect öncesi XP kuralının aynı maç için yalnız bir kez uygulanması. Daha eski 2-insan ana oyun PASS kayıtları saklı; sadece yeni/eksik spesifik senaryolar test edilecek. 3/4 gerçek insan genişletilmiş test ayrıca DEFERRED.
- **P1 / LIVE EMOTE SEND + REGISTERED REST INVENTORY — PARTIALLY ACCEPTED / OPEN SEND QA:** Career envanterinde emote sahipliği ve çıkarma daha önce owner PASS; fakat lobby/in-game SEND'in aynı UID yetkisiyle diğer oyuncu avatarı üstünde görünmesi güncel iki istemcili testle doğrulanmadı. Kabul edilmiş envanteri veya katalogu sıfırdan yaratma.
- **P1 / REDEEM-PROMO / EVENT / SERVER STATUS LOCALIZATION — OPEN OR PARTIAL:** Kod Kullan için güvenilir Spark/RTDB redemption authority ve gerçek kod akışı doğrulanmadı; Event ekranı için gerçek etkinlik içeriği ayrı ürün işi; Server Status teknik etiketlerini gizleme Owner PASS fakat native/REST/offline + yedi dil kabul matrisi açık. Bunları birbiriyle veya satın alma ile bağlama.
- **P1 / RTDB SECURITY RELEASE GATES — OPEN:** App Check production enforcement ve aktif rules deployment sürümü kanıtı; yetkili Host'un semantik olarak sahte `snapshotJson` yazabilmesi ve kimliği doğrulanmış oyuncunun yoğun intent oluşturabilmesi (risk kararı / trusted authority veya rate limit); `phase19cc` değişiklikleri için gerçek Auth+RTDB emulator güvenlik regresyonu. Geçmiş emulator PASS sonuçlarını silme veya güncel değişikliklere yanlışlıkla taşıma.
- **P1 / ANDROID + GOOGLE PLAY/STEAM RELEASE ACCEPTANCE — OPEN:** Android uzun süreli FPS, gerçek cihaz/Guest Build, 7 dil, Play Store görsel/AAB/reviewer ve Steam üretim/asset lisans kontrolleri ayrı yayın kapılarıdır. Mağaza varlıkları ve release öncesi geliştirici/tester erişimlerinin kısıtlanması incelenmeli.
- **P1 / SERVER-ENFORCED VERSION GATE — DEFERRED BY OWNER:** Güncel istemcinin protocol/version UI guard'ı eski istemcileri Firebase üzerinde zorunlu reddetmez. Sahip açıkça seçmedikçe uygulanmaz; release güvenlik borcu olarak görünür kalır.

**Güncel test/doğruluk özeti:** `OWNER_PASS=3/3 (LOCAL_STEAM_NAME, LOCAL_REMATCH, PROFILE_FRAME)`; `SOURCE_GATE=58/58 (son v5.49.12cf kaynak testi)`; `ONLINE_DICE_TWO_UID=OWNER_PENDING`; `ONLINE_REJOIN_FINAL_REWARDS=TARGETED_QA_PENDING`; `RETAIL_STEAM_IDENTITY=OPEN`; `GUEST_CONVERSION_RELEASE=OPEN`; `PRODUCTION_SECURITY=OPEN`; `SERVER_VERSION_GATE=OWNER_DEFERRED`. Daha önceki lokal `LOCAL_OFFLINE` zar testinin Gold/XP üretmemesi expected behavior'dır. GitHub `main` okuma anında `5b74a04b3b1c503ce38fb6d085cca2da35e61c42` (v5.49.12cc) olduğundan **v5.49.12cd/ce/cf tam yerel dosyalar push edilmiş varsayılmaz**. GitHub için Summary/Description bu owner tarafından talep edildi; **push ayrıca açıkça yapılmadan yapılmış sayılmaz**. Kullanıcı onayı olmadan production mutation, Firebase deploy, eski hesap/ödül geçmişi değişikliği yok.

**Çalışma/teslim sınırları:** Tek kanonik roadmap + mevcut frontend error codebook dışında yeni MD oluşturma; kodu ve roadmap'i okuyup duplicate sistem ekleme; yalnız değişen tam dosyaları **tek ZIP** içinde proje-bağıl yollarla teslim et; PS1, BAT, patch veya diff göndermeme; GitHub yedeğini sadece owner istediğinde gerçekleştir. Bu checkpoint yalnız belgedir ve oyun kodunu değiştirmez.

# ATLASBOARD — v5.49.12cf / 2026-11-03 LOCAL REMATCH, STEAM HOST NAME, FRAME MENU RECONCILIATION

**Tek kanonik roadmap:** `Assets/Project/Documentation/MASTER_ROADMAP.md`. Bu kaynak paketi, önceki `v5.49.12ce` ve tüm eski roadmap tarihçesini koruyarak hazırlanmıştır. ## Owner test sonucu, kanıt ve beklenen davranış

- Owner, Steam ile giriş yapan **Vuartex** hesabını ve kuşanılmış profil çerçevesini Career/Store'da gördü. Aynı hesapta main-menu ve local-private-lobby avatar kutusunda çerçeve görünmedi. Main-menu üzerinde cüzdan/profil kaynakları ayrışıyor: Career/Store kanonik `users/<uid>/metaEconomy.equipped.profileFrameId` kaydını, eski native menu header ise `publicProfiles/<uid>.profileFrameId` projeksiyonunu birincil kaynak okuyordu. Mevcut `AtlasBoardCanonicalProfileHeader.cs` içinde doğrulanmış cüzdandan native Steam account için UID-sınırlı 20 saniyelik read-only frame uzlaştırması eklendi; REST UID koruması ve eski overlay çizimi korunuyor. Gerçek Unity testine kadar görsel sonuç owner doğrulamasına açıktır.
- Owner, `PRIVATE TABLE -> Local Offline` modunda Steam host koltuğunda `PLAYER (YOU)` gördü. Mevcut `RefreshHostSeatRows()` backend member mevcut değilse sabit fallback kullanıyordu. Aynı metodun yalnız `backendSnapshot==null && roomCode==empty` local-only durumunda `AtlasBoardCanonicalPlayerIdentity.ValidSteamPersona()` ve mevcut local canonical alias kullanması sağlandı. Host migration, online backend displayName ve remote seats değişmedi.
- Owner, tek Steam hesabı + yerel bot ile oynadığı maçın sonucu sonrası `REMATCH` düğmesinin Main Menu'ye dönmesini raporladı. `MatchResultManager.RestartMatch()` local durumda `SceneManager.LoadScene()` çalıştırarak ana menüyü açıyordu. `AtlasBoardOfflineModeBootstrap.TryReturnLocalMatchToLobby()` ile yalnız halen aktif, yerel host-owned ve online room code'u bulunmayan private local room mevcutsa **mevcut** `AtlasBoardMainMenuController.ReturnOnlineMatchToLobby()` reset yoluna geçildi. Eski offline 5 saniyelik Start/countdown butonu, host settings ve host-seat UI tekrar etkinleştirildi; online rematch aynı `RequestOnlineRematch()` akışını kullanıyor. Fallback başka offline oyun modları için scene reload olarak durur.
- Ekli logda `ATB_SESSION_MODE mode=LocalOffline ... rewards=false` ve `ATB_CAREER_DICE_CLOUD stage=loaded stored_matches=0 rolls=0` görülüyor. **Bu modda Gold, XP, permanent Career zar statları kazanılmaması beklenen kuraldır; bug diye ödül kapısı değiştirilmedi.** Cloud zar test senaryosu iki ayrı Firebase Auth UID'li gerçek online oyunda (özel veya public) tamamlanan ve sunucu tarafından onaylanan maçın ardından yapılmalıdır. Starting-order zarları Career sayacına eklenmez; yalnız tamamlanmış otoritatif oyun zarları kapsamdadır. `careerDiceObservations` append-only/UID-scoped yapısı aynı kaldı. Önceki zar düzeltmesinin iki-client kabulü hâlâ BEKLİYOR.

## Yalnız değişen tam kaynak dosyalar

1. `Assets/Project/Scripts/UI/Menu/AtlasBoardCanonicalProfileHeader.cs`: native Steam UID için canonical wallet equipped profile frame sorgusu ve revision kontrolü; REST profil hesabı değişim guard'ları korunuyor.

4. `Assets/Project/Scripts/Core/MatchResultManager.cs`: yalnız gerçek explicit local private offline rematch için mevcut lobiye dönüş, diğer modların fallback'ı korunuyor.

6. Yalnız bu mevcut `MASTER_ROADMAP.md` güncellendi; **başka MD, PS1, patch, ikinci manager veya alternatif roadmap oluşturulmadı.** `FRONTEND_ERROR_CODEBOOK.md`, güvenlik kuralları, Store/DAILY/DEV_GRANT, satın alma geçmişi ve Gold/XP ödül kodu değiştirilmedi.

Follower sahip olduğu maç için count>0, sum/high=0 kaydedebiliyordu; mevcut `careerDiceObservations/<uid>/<matchId>` sayısal doğrulaması da bunu reddeder. Eski kayıtlar uydurma değerlerle doldurulmaz.

## v5.49.12bk — Steam/Firebase cross-account isolation and Guest promotion security audit (2026-11-02; P0 BLOCKED / NO SOURCE FIX APPLIED)

**Source authority:** Live GitHub `vuartex/AtlasBoardPrototype` `main` HEAD `3e869ce43ed6632567effd25b609176b062cdb52` at inspection; owner confirmed the `bj` GitHub backup. Read-only owner-provided production RTDB export was inspected for schema and aggregate counts, **without importing, deleting, editing or displaying UID/PII/token data**. This checkpoint is **DOCUMENTATION-ONLY** and does NOT claim to solve the vulnerabilities. Preserve all 10,xxx preceding canonical roadmap lines verbatim below. Do not commit or push except at owner's explicit request.

### P0 confirmed user-facing symptom and source findings

- Owner switched between two different actual Steam accounts, but the game showed prior Steam player's profile frame, Gold/Atlas Coin, purchase inventory and identity. This is an **account isolation incident**, NOT merely a display-name bug. Repro requires two true SteamIDs and their corresponding Firebase UIDs; never assume a changed Steam persona implies a changed Firebase Auth principal.
- `AtlasBoardAccountService.CurrentAccountId` is `FirebaseAuth.DefaultInstance.CurrentUser.UserId` and persists independently of Steam identity. `AtlasBoardPlatformRuntime.TryAutomaticReturningSteamSignInAsync` can fail and explicitly continue with **the current Atlas identity**; `AtlasBoardSteamAccountLinkBridge` has a verified ticket/custom-token returning-sign-in path but an unlinked Steam account does not thereby own the existing Firebase UID. Auto sign-in is initiated once per Steam provider readiness, not proved for runtime SteamID switch.
- `AtlasBoardAccountService.RegisterWithEmailPasswordAsync` unconditionally uses `auth.CreateUserWithEmailAndPasswordAsync`, generating a distinct Firebase account instead of **linking** the current anonymous Firebase UID. `AtlasBoardAccountService.SignOut()` only calls `auth.SignOut()`. `AtlasBoardAccountAccessUI.SignOut` resets its own display-name state but not every cached wallet/History/Shop/profile/Steam/online state. Existing `AtlasBoardRtdbMetaEconomy` has UID-scoped caches and the account/profile UI has async loads; audit all race paths.
- Current source **already correctly maintains** `general.accountType='guest'` for Firebase anonymous Auth and `'registered'` for nonanonymous Auth, enforced by RTDB Rules. Do not replace this authentication type with user-writable `admin`. Distinct administrative permissions belong to server-enforced roles / claims, not editable profile metadata.
- User-provided RTDB export: **10 user records; 8 registered, 2 guest; 2 with `metaEconomy` wallets**; nine public profiles; no `users/{uid}/guestOrigin` schema and no Steam link records at RTDB root. Steam links may reside in a different backing service; **absence in an RTDB export is not proof no external Steam links exist**. The export is a historical snapshot, not the guaranteed live production state. **Do not bulk-restore or migrate this export.**

### Required single-identity model; mandatory before launch

1. **Authoritative identity key is Firebase Auth UID, not display name/device/Steam persona alone.** Registered email/password, verified linked Steam, Android and future providers resolve to exactly one canonical UID. For Steam, require signed/verified Steam Web API ticket -> backend mapping -> expected Firebase Auth custom-token UID **before loading any prior private wallet, Career or owned cosmetics**. On SteamID switch, block sensitive UI and network actions until resolution; never silently reuse another Steam account's existing Firebase session.
2. **Guest -> New Email account upgrade:** if current principal is **actually** Firebase Anonymous, call Firebase Unity `EmailAuthProvider.GetCredential` + `CurrentUser.LinkWithCredentialAsync`. Require returned UID exactly equals pre-link anonymous UID, refresh token/auth state and update RTDB `general.accountType` to `registered` using Rules-validated current account. **No wallet/XP/inventory/claim copies or re-credits.** If the target email already belongs to a different UID, fail closed and display an explicit merge-required path, never overwrite either account. Firebase documents a linking-credentials issue; inspect SDK version and test on Auth+RTDB Emulator before production rollout.
3. **Logout:** leave active lobby, clear local identity-bound presentation/transactions/async requests, sign out, then establish a **new or restored permitted anonymous Firebase principal** for guest mode. Do NOT reuse the upgraded registered UID as a guest or automatically grant previously owned items. Former account's wallet remains stored at its registered UID and comes back on authentic sign-in. `PlayerPrefs` local Guest alias alone is not a trustworthy cloud wallet. A real Firebase Guest that earned Gold retains it only while that same authenticated UID remains accessible.
4. **Guest origin provenance:** design `/users/{canonicalUid}/guestOrigin/{originalGuestUid,originalGuestName,linkedAt,originAccountType,originalBalancesSnapshot,...}` as an **immutable, server-validated provenance record**; original UID is explicitly named, never mixed with current canonical UID. Historical Gold, XP and claim evidence are snapshots / read-only audit fields, **not additional spendable balances**. Live Gold remains only `/users/{uid}/metaEconomy`; XP/History remain existing canonical Career evidence. Rules must prevent client forging a prior UID, tampering with an `originalBalancesSnapshot` or linking another account, and cannot simply trust client-supplied XP. Schema/Rules, atomic promotion marker and emulator negative tests must be designed and approved before deploying. For same-UID promotion, originalGuestUid == current UID is a valid identity-history fact, not a new balance owner.
5. **Cached UI and async safety:** On every UID/provider transition invalidate previous UID-scoped `AtlasBoardCanonicalProfileHeader`, `AtlasBoardUnifiedProfilePresentation`, account access UI, `AtlasBoardRtdbMetaEconomy` caches (dice/board/pawn/emote/wallet), Career/XP/achievements, Store/inventory, lobby transport Auth token, profile avatar/frame, pending requests and per-UID local prefs. Async callbacks must recheck requested UID and current Auth UID before rendering. No blank/zero display should silently become verified wallet; fail closed with loading/sign-in state.
6. **Migration for existing legacy Steam QA UID:** Preserve existing user records, allowlist and purchases. Require owner-only controlled link/recovery using verified Steam proof and explicit ownership confirmation; do not sign out/replace anonymous credentials blindly or guess which existing UID belongs to a SteamID. Never merge two wallet ledgers without immutable conflict/replay/entitlement reconciliation and owner approval.

### Acceptance matrix (all OPEN / NOT RUN)

- A Steam account -> exactly its linked Firebase UID; B Steam account -> a distinct UID, zero leakage of name, frame, Gold, Atlas Coin, Career/XP/History, inventory or private lobby state. A -> B -> A with app restart and in-session switch. Unlinked B: no access to A, no silent A fallback. Account identity changed mid-async load: old result discarded.
- Registered A -> Sign out -> anonymous guest C: new/verified guest principal and only its own data; Guest C -> New Email `LinkWithCredentialAsync`: UID unchanged, wallet amount/XP/claims/inventory/history unchanged; login from Android/Windows to that email recovers same UID/state. Guest C -> existing email D: no automatic merge/no data theft.
- Two independent registered accounts A and D switch repeatedly on one Windows/Android installation; no cross-UID visual caches. Steam provider is separate from email credential identity; explicit binding rules. Reconnect, Host Migration, Rematch and rewards retain only exact UID.
- Auth + RTDB Emulator deny/allow tests: forged guestOrigin, reused foreign UID, duplicate link, double-credit, replay, wrong Steam proof, UID mismatch, anonymous vs registered, app restart, stale concurrent responses. Browser/Unity/Steam/Android live acceptance only after authentic emulator PASS and owner-reviewed production rollout.

### Release-gate count (grouped, not literal count of every historic roadmap entry)

**12 active major release gates:** (1) Steam verified identity/account switch P0, (2) Guest conversion and logout preservation P0, (3) identity cache & asynchronous cross-UID isolation P0, (4) server-enforced client version admission, (5) production App Check + RTDB rules deployment review, (6) host-authored semantic trust decision, (7) unique-intent abuse/throttling decision, (8) extended 3/4-real-human multiplayer, (9) sustained Android performance especially S20 FE, (10) Steam/Windows production platform build/review, (11) Google Play account access/data safety/AAB/release compliance, (12) third-party licensing/credits, privacy/account deletion and final GO/NO-GO. These are **work packages**; many comprise multiple subchecks. Previous two-human Phase18, Rematch, Career/Gold, Auction and basic Emulator hardening remain OWNER PASS for previously tested versions and are not reopened automatically.

**STATUS:** SECURITY INCIDENT CONFIRMED BY OWNER; ROOT-CAUSE PATHS IDENTIFIED; NO CODE FIX, NO UNITY COMPILE, NO NEW EMULATOR TEST, NO STEAM A/B LIVE TEST. No production Firebase changes, no GitHub commit/push. The live production release gate is **NO-GO** until the P0 account isolation issues are actually fixed and validated.

### v0.5.0 release version and online compatibility — new Unity source candidate

**User-facing release version:** `v0.5.0`, deliberately not `0.01`/`0.1.0`. The canonical existing Main Menu now receives one compact, right-anchored runtime TMPro version badge at the bottom-right, without repurposing the rotating localized `FooterVersion` tip or creating a parallel menu manager. It displays `Application.version`, not a fabricated independent UI version. This badge is attached only once to the existing `AtlasBoardMainMenuController` GameObject and disappears naturally when the Main Menu panel is hidden.

**Unity version settings:** new Editor-only `AtlasBoardReleaseVersionEditor` upgrades only known legacy `PlayerSettings.bundleVersion=0.1.0` or `0.1` to `0.5.0` on script import and bumps Android `bundleVersionCode` from less than 5 to 5. It deliberately does not overwrite an owner-set future release version. Unity must actually reimport scripts and serialize ProjectSettings before the game or Android/Windows builds display the new version; the Assistant did not compile Unity or build an AAB/EXE.

**Compatibility version contract (updated clients):** existing `AtlasOnlineDefaults.ProtocolVersion` advances **1 -> 2** for this deliberate cross-client compatibility boundary; `RulesVersion=1` and `ContentVersion=1` remain unchanged because RTDB Rules and content format are unchanged. The existing `AtlasBoardLobbyRuntimeBridge` already supplies `Application.version`, ProtocolVersion, RulesVersion and ContentVersion when creating rooms and joining public/private rooms. A lightweight `AtlasBoardReleaseVersionBadge` subscribes to that same bridge's `SnapshotChanged`, validates **all four** values exactly on current and subsequent snapshots (including resumed/reconnected snapshots), and fails closed on a mismatch: the current Host closes its incompatible room or a follower leaves; then local lobby state is cleared and the main menu reopens with an UPDATE REQUIRED marker localized for TR/EN/ES/FR/DE/KO/RU. Log prefix `ATB_VERSION_COMPATIBLE false` records both version tuples; the app does not silently blend an old game's save/snapshot schema with a new one.

**SERVER_VERSION_ENFORCEMENT=OPEN — release blocker, do not mislabel as solved.** This implementation is a cooperative current-client compatibility guard, **not** an enforced claim that all versions are rejected by Firebase RTDB. Existing Spark `roomMeta` does not currently require a signed `gameVersion/protocolVersion/contentVersion` tuple and existing joinRequests/roomMembers do not verify a joiner's exact build version in RTDB Rules before admission. An **older unmodified 0.1.0 client** therefore has no new client-side mismatch guard and may still try to join a 0.5.0 Host; the Host cannot reliably authenticate its remote software build from the current schema. Also, `Application.version` does not prove identical code/assets across platforms if a developer forgets to bump it. Fully guaranteed same-update admission requires a **separate deliberate backend contract change** (version-bound room metadata, join-request validation, host acceptance gate and public/private/reconnect tests), full Auth+RTDB emulator regression **again**, and an owner-approved production rollout plan. Do not patch RTDB Rules opportunistically or call this complete from a source smoke.

**Version scope:** GameVersion `0.5.0` means cross-platform compatible update; ProtocolVersion 2 is the gameplay/lobby networking compatibility epoch, not an individual device build GUID. Changing the networking frame/serialized economy/rules in a future update requires a deliberate epoch/version bump, not a UI-only label change. Android `versionCode` is a monotonically increasing Play Store build counter, separate from the visible marketing version.

The owner executed the real Auth+Database Emulator command:

```powershell
Set-Location "C:\Users\crazy\AtlasBoardPrototype\Backend\Firebase"

The actual `roomMeta/$roomId` rule authorizes the active remote member's Host takeover when the old `matchState.hostHeartbeatAt <= now - 12000` and the normal authority/epoch/member checks hold. HTTP 200 is consistent with that stale-heartbeat branch, not proof of a live Host takeover vulnerability.

The existing admin-only later fixture still sets `hostHeartbeatAt:q.now()-13000` to test the legitimate stale-heartbeat migration. No broadening of authorization is permitted to make a test PASS.
